scope: Found during authenticated production Drive acceptance on 2026-10-28: the browser blocked the direct upload to the private R2 bucket because the website Content Security Policy connect-src did not list the bucket origin. Allow exactly the xroga-drive-prod bucket origin, only when NEXT_PUBLIC_XROGA_DRIVE=1. No backend, schema, credential or wildcard change.

keep: The signed-URL upload design: bytes never pass through the API
The bucket's own CORS rules (xroga.com origins only, GET PUT HEAD, ETag exposed)
extend: connect-src gains one exact bucket origin, gated by the Drive switch

auth.description: No authentication change. Signed upload URLs are still issued by the authenticated backend for the caller's own tenant.

tenant.description: No tenant boundary change. Object keys remain server-derived per tenant.

credentials.description: No credential handling change. The bucket origin is a public identifier, not a secret.

egress.description: The browser may now connect to one exact private-bucket origin when Drive is on. No wildcard, no public bucket, and the origin is absent when the Drive switch is off.

cost.description: No cost change. R2 usage stays inside the existing per-tenant quota.

tests.scope: Policy contains the exact bucket origin with Drive on; absent with Drive unset, empty or 0; never a wildcard; existing allowances unchanged. Three tests PASS.

architecture.reason: One configuration value in the existing security header. No new service, route or runtime.

rollout: Merge after required checks. Vercel rebuilds production with NEXT_PUBLIC_XROGA_DRIVE=1 already set. Then repeat the authenticated Drive upload test.
rollback: Revert the commit and redeploy, or unset NEXT_PUBLIC_XROGA_DRIVE in Vercel to hide the Drive screen and drop the origin from the policy.
knownGaps: Authenticated upload, download, delete, quota and isolation results are recorded only after this reaches production
placeholderClaimsRemaining: Drive is not accepted until the authenticated live tests pass

blockers: Required CI checks and founder authorization to merge
Authenticated live Drive acceptance after deploy
